lines.text: The LORD calls Ararat, Minni, Ashkenaz, and the kings of the Medes to prepare for battle against Babylon.
Babylon's warriors sit in their strongholds, and messengers tell the king his city has been captured from end to end.
The LORD says Babylon is like a trampled threshing floor, and the dweller of Zion says Pharaoh devoured her.
The LORD will take vengeance, dry up Babylon's sea, and serve the people a feast so they sleep forever.
Babylon's cities become a desolation, and the LORD will punish Molech, so the nations no longer stream to him.
